[[File:Skyfighter.png|thumb|right|200px|A skyfighter]]
A '''skyfighter''' was a combat vessel that was used solely for air-to-air combat. The [[Exocron Airfleet]] used skyfighters extensively, operating both the [[Skylark]] and the [[Skyraptor]]. The [[Corsairs]] of the western canyons also flew skyfighters called [[Corsair Raider|Raiders]].

Skyfighters were used during the [[Conquest of Makeb]] by forces of the [[InterStellar Regulators]] under [[the Warhound]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=faction|[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]]|A Cure of Armageddon|[[Makeb]]}}</ref>
